entries.title: SOMA
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC build with Safe Mode

emulation.notes: Use the current native PC build for capture and choose Normal or Safe Mode at the start of a new game.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with scalable settings and capture flexibility.

primary.version: Current PC build with Safe Mode
primary.why: The current Windows PC build is the best route because it has the full game, the official Safe Mode option, and the strongest settings/capture flexibility. No sourced platform-exclusive story content was identified elsewhere.
primary.how_to_play: Buy SOMA on Steam or GOG and play the current Windows PC build. Choose Normal Mode for the original survival-horror pressure or Safe Mode for Frictional's official less-lethal variant.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original game with later Safe Mode support; no sourced remaster/remake distinction applies.
